Title: Office Administrator
OriginalDescription:
Posted Tuesday, September 1, 2026, 6:00 AM

Office Administrator

Reports To: Community Manager

About YES:

Founded in 2008, YES Communities has established itself as a leader in the manufactured housing space. YES is the largest privately held manufactured housing REIT in the country. Our commitment to improving communities and enhancing the lives of our residents is evident in our long-standing industry presence and the experience of our leadership team. This dedication and expertise have earned YES recognition and respect in the field, underscoring our significant role in shaping the manufactured housing landscape.

Office Administrator Position Overview:

In this role, you will be expected to perform a variety of office management and support tasks including answering phones, greeting customers, preparing correspondence, maintaining office files, ordering office supplies, and taking payments from residents. As the brand ambassador for YES Communities, your presence, and overall professionalism will be on full display. You will also assist your Community Manager with the timely completion of projects and help maintain a positive community environment.

Office Administrator Essential Functions:

  1. Assists residents, visitors, and vendors with inquiries/requests in person and via phone
  2. Prepares and distributes resident correspondence
  3. Administer office operations including but not limited to maintaining files, office inventory, documentation processing and scheduling.
  4. Input and schedule resident maintenance requests including work orders and home inspections
  5. Collect payments from residents and assist with electronic payment set-up
  6. Assist with the move-in/move-out processes as directed by the manager
  7. Assists with planning and coordinating resident relations events
  8. Additional duties as assigned by management and are subject to change

Office Administrator Required Skills:

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Must be self-motivated, independent and able to work with minimal supervision
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and industry specific software products

Office Administrator Education and Experience:

  • A valid in-state driver's license is required
  • High School Diploma or equivalent is preferred
  • Previous administration or customer service experience preferred

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Yes Communities recruiters only contact you from @yescommunities.com email addresses. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Yes Communities recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links - visit yescommunities.com/careers/ directly for confirmed position openings.

The YES Difference

Competitive salary | Comprehensive health benefits | Life, long and short-term disability insurance | 401(k) with company match

YES Communities is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Pay Type: Hourly

Hiring Min Rate: 17 USD

Hiring Max Rate: 17 USD

Sales & Leasing Agent Position Overview:

In this role, you will be playing an active role in the selling and leasing of new, used, foreclosed, and broker homes in your community. You will be working with a high-performing team, driven by success, and will be delivering the highest quality of service to current and prospective renters and home buyers. You will also act as a liaison between Yes Communities team members, potential/existing homeowners, and local organizations. You will leverage your marketing/advertising skills to connect with prospective residents through a number of different mediums, both online and in person. Sales & Leasing Agent Essential Functions:

  1. Facilitating sales and leasing operations such as prospect tracking, appointment scheduling, conducting tours, application assistance, third-party communications, and closings.

  3. Act as a liaison between internal departments, external entities and the applicant
  4. Collaborate with management team to monitor homes for move-in readiness
  5. Hold open houses/sales events as needed
  6. Organize resident events to promote YES culture and maintain relationships
  7. Attend all company meetings, trainings, and conferences as requested.

Reports To: Community Manager

About YES:

Founded in 2008, YES Communities has established itself as a leader in the manufactured housing space. YES is the largest privately held manufactured housing REIT in the country. Our commitment to improving communities and enhancing the lives of our residents is evident in our long-standing industry presence and the experience of our leadership team. This dedication and expertise have earned YES recognition and respect in the field, underscoring our significant role in shaping the manufactured housing landscape.

Sales & Leasing Agent Position Overview:

In this role, you will be playing an active role in the selling and leasing of new, used, foreclosed, and broker homes in your community. You will be working with a high-performing team, driven by success, and will be delivering the highest quality of service to current and prospective renters and home buyers. You will also act as a liaison between Yes Communities team members, potential/existing homeowners, and local organizations. You will leverage your marketing/advertising skills to connect with prospective residents through a number of different mediums, both online and in person. This will include building relationships with both existing and future community residents.

Sales & Leasing Agent Essential Functions:

  1. Facilitating sales and leasing operations such as prospect tracking, appointment scheduling, conducting tours, application assistance, third-party communications, and closings.
  2. Advertise and generate leads through multiple avenues (phone calls, e-mail, social media, and physical delivery of flyers/promotions to residents, etc.)
  3. Act as a liaison between internal departments, external entities and the applicant
  4. Collaborate with management team to monitor homes for move-in readiness
  5. Hold open houses/sales events as needed
  6. Organize resident events to promote YES culture and maintain relationships
  7. Attend all company meetings, trainings, and conferences as requested.
  8. Additional duties assigned by management and are subject to change.

Sales & Leasing Agent Required Skills:

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Must be self-motivated, independent, and able to work with minimal supervision.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and industry specific software products
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, metric-driven environment
  • Excels in a collaborative/team-oriented environment
  • Ability to work some evenings and weekends

Sales & Leasing Agent Education and Experience:

  • A valid in-state driver's license required
  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred
  • Prior customer service/sales experience strongly preferred.
  • Must obtain state-specific sales licensing within 90 days of employment where applicable

If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links - visit yescommunities.com/careers/ directly for confirmed position openings.

The YES Difference

Competitive salary | Comprehensive health benefits | Life, long and short-term disability insurance | 401(k) with company match

YES Communities is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Hiring Max Rate: 18 USD

  3. Aid in rent collections efforts for all assigned communities including assisting with evictions, utility cut off's and issuing non-compliance notices to residents.
  4. Professionally resolve resident communications and concerns
  5. Provide hands-on leadership and management support to all team members
  6. Assist with the recruitment, training, and development of team members when needed
  7. Create and maintain a positive Community environment including resident activities and regional events
  8. Develop and maintain positive relationships with cities, municipalities, and counties
  9. Create and ensure a safe work environment

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Versatility and ability to adapt to changing needs of assigned communities
  • Must be self-motivated, independent, and able to work with minimal supervision
  • Strong leadership and decision-making skills
  • Demonstrated ability to motivate and manage team performance

Reports To: Regional Manager

About YES:

Founded in 2008, YES Communities has established itself as a leader in the manufactured housing space. YES is the largest privately held manufactured housing REIT in the country. Our commitment to improving communities and enhancing the lives of our residents is evident in our long-standing industry presence and the experience of our leadership team. This dedication and expertise have earned YES recognition and respect in the field, underscoring our significant role in shaping the manufactured housing landscape.

Community Manager Position Overview:

As a Community Manager, you play a very important leadership role not only with existing team members but with the residents of our communities as well. You will perform regular operational tasks such as collecting rent, managing supplies and marketing materials, developing the team, and protecting all company assets. In addition to this, you are also the main source of communication for the residents and will be the point person when it comes to resolving all complaints that come through your office. You must be able to make executive decisions when it comes to financial success and the overall safety and conditions of your community. Your commitment to communicating community successes and challenges with your immediate supervisor and your team members will ensure your team's alignment with company goals and objectives.

Community Manager Essential Functions:

  1. Manage daily community operations, including but not limited to: evictions, collections, resident relations, maintain community budget, and protect all company assets
  2. Recruit, train, manage, and develop team members.
  3. Conduct consistent team meetings to reinforce expectations and facilitate employee growth
  4. Manage the marketing, sale, leasing, and turn of all new, used, foreclosed, and broker homes to ensure ongoing success and high occupancy of the community
  5. Develop and maintain positive relationships with vendors, cities, municipalities, and counties
  6. Plan and oversee community events to help maintain a positive community environment
  7. Coordinate with residents to uphold property standards
  8. Travel to/attend company meetings, trainings, and conferences as requested by management.
  9. Coordinate new home delivery and set-up, and request any warranty or follow-up work with manufacturers
  10. Additional duties as assigned by management subject to change

Community Manager Required Skills:

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Strong conflict resolution skills
  • Strong leadership and decision-making skills, including management of team member performance
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and industry specific software products
  • Proven ability to adapt to new or unforeseen situations
  • Must obtain or transfer state-specific licensing within 90 days of employment (in applicable states)

Community Manager Education and Experience:

  • A valid in-state driver's license is required
  • High School Diploma or equivalent is preferred
  • Property management or equivalent experience is preferred

Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Yes Communities recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links - visit yescommunities.com/careers/ directly for confirmed position openings.

The YES Difference

Competitive salary | Comprehensive health benefits | Life, long and short-term disability insurance | 401(k) with company match

YES Communities is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Grounds Keeper

Reports To: Community Manager

About YES:

Founded in 2008, YES Communities has established itself as a leader in the manufactured housing space. YES is the largest privately held manufactured housing REIT in the country. Our commitment to improving communities and enhancing the lives of our residents is evident in our long-standing industry presence and the experience of our leadership team. This dedication and expertise have earned YES recognition and respect in the field, underscoring our significant role in shaping the manufactured housing landscape.

Grounds Keeper Position Overview:

In this role, you'll be essential in keeping our community grounds and facilities well-maintained and visually appealing. Responsibilities include cleaning up trash and debris, raking leaves, sweeping walkways, mowing lawns, and trimming trees and hedges. In addition, your main focus will be adding curb appeal to the community.

Grounds Keeper Essential Functions:

  1. Maintain community assets including grounds, buildings, equipment, pools, etc.
  2. Mow lawns and trim edges around walks, flower beds, etc.
  3. Landscaping, including but not limited to, mowing, trimming, planting flowers, maintaining tree limbs and prune the grounds as needed
  4. Perform minor repairs on equipment utilized in groundskeeping
  5. Follow all OSHA standards and maintain PPE equipment
  6. Respond to emergency calls as directed by management if applicable.
  7. Communicate effectively with team members, vendors, and residents.
  8. Assist with maintenance tasks, including but not limited to delivering notices and conducting meter reads as directed by the community manager
  9. Maintain safe winter road conditions through snow removal and de-icing when applicable
  10. Additional duties as assigned by management and subject to change

Grounds Keeper Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to stand and walk for up to eight (8) hours per day
  • Use of hands, including fingers, to handle or feel objects, tools, or controls in a repetitive motion.
  • Capacity to reach with arms and hands overhead and in front of your body safely.
  • Frequently required to be flexible by climbing, balancing, or occasionally crawling in confined spaces
  • Ability to see clearly at both far and close distances as well as the capacity to adjust focus effectively.
  • Required to regularly push, pull, lift, or carry 50 lbs. Occasionally up to 85 lbs.
  • Proper handling of potentially hazardous chemicals
  • Must be able to climb ladders, occasionally up to an 8-foot ladder safely

Grounds Keeper Education and Experience:

  • A valid in-state driver's license is required
  • A high school diploma or equivalent is preferred
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and industry specific software products including the use of electronic devices, such as a work tablet or computer
  • OSHA certifications or completed trainings are a plus

About YES:

Founded in 2008, YES Communities has established itself as a leader in the manufactured housing space. YES is the largest privately held manufactured housing REIT in the country. Our commitment to improving communities and enhancing the lives of our residents is evident in our long-standing industry presence and the experience of our leadership team. This dedication and expertise have earned YES recognition and respect in the field, underscoring our significant role in shaping the manufactured housing landscape.

Grounds Keeper Position Overview:

In this role, you'll be essential in keeping our community grounds and facilities well-maintained and visually appealing. Responsibilities include cleaning up trash and debris, raking leaves, sweeping walkways, mowing lawns, and trimming trees and hedges. In addition, your main focus will be adding curb appeal to the community.

Grounds Keeper Essential Functions:

  1. Maintain community assets including grounds, buildings, equipment, pools, etc.
  2. Mow lawns and trim edges around walks, flower beds, etc.
  3. Landscaping, including but not limited to, mowing, trimming, planting flowers, maintaining tree limbs and prune the grounds as needed
  4. Perform minor repairs on equipment utilized in groundskeeping
  5. Follow all OSHA standards and maintain PPE equipment
  6. Respond to emergency calls as directed by management if applicable.
  7. Communicate effectively with team members, vendors, and residents.
  8. Assist with maintenance tasks, including but not limited to delivering notices and conducting meter reads as directed by the community manager
  9. Maintain safe winter road conditions through snow removal and de-icing when applicable
  10. Additional duties as assigned by management and subject to change

Grounds Keeper Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to stand and walk for up to eight (8) hours per day
  • Use of hands, including fingers, to handle or feel objects, tools, or controls in a repetitive motion.
  • Capacity to reach with arms and hands overhead and in front of your body safely.
  • Frequently required to be flexible by climbing, balancing, or occasionally crawling in confined spaces
  • Ability to see clearly at both far and close distances as well as the capacity to adjust focus effectively.
  • Required to regularly push, pull, lift, or carry 50 lbs. Occasionally up to 85 lbs.
  • Proper handling of potentially hazardous chemicals
  • Must be able to climb ladders, occasionally up to an 8-foot ladder safely

Grounds Keeper Education and Experience:

  • A valid in-state driver's license is required
  • A high school diploma or equivalent is preferred
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and industry specific software products including the use of electronic devices, such as a work tablet or computer
  • OSHA certifications or completed trainings are a plus

You will be interacting with residents and ensuring the timely and satisfactory completion of service requests and inspections. You will also be a key player in the upkeep of community assets and grounds. Teamwork is also an essential key to success in this role.

Maintenance Technician Essential Functions:

  1. Maintain rental inventory through preventative maintenance, work-orders, and home refurbs.
  2. Keep the community grounds, common areas, and vacant lots clean and free of debris and trash.
  3. Complete all work in a timely manner, without sacrificing quality or safety standards.
  4. Respond to after-hour emergency calls according to on-call schedule.
  5. Read water meters, identify, and resolve leaks within the community as applicable.
  6. Organize maintenance facilities, tools, and equipment.
  7. Aid in new home delivery and set-up and report any warranty/follow-up work to management.
  8. Deliver resident notices as requested by management.
  9. Participate in all required team/safety meetings.
  10. Uphold OSHA standards and maintain Personal Protective Equipment as required by State law.
  11. Maintain safe winter road conditions through snow removal and de-icing when applicable.
  12. Operate and maintain all company vehicles according to compliance and safety standards.
  13. Communicate effectively with team members, vendors, and residents.
  14. Ability to work safely around pets, service animals, and wildlife.
  15. Additional duties as assigned by management and subject to change.

Maintenance Technician Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to stand and walk for up to eight (8) hours per day
  • Use of hands, including fingers, to handle or feel objects, tools, or controls in a repetitive motion.
  • Capacity to reach with arms and hands overhead and in front of your body safely.
  • Frequently required to be flexible by climbing, balancing, or occasionally crawling in confined spaces
  • Ability to see clearly at both far and close distances as well as the capacity to adjust focus effectively.
  • Required to regularly push, pull, lift, or carry 50 lbs. Occasionally up to 85 lbs.
  • Proper handling of potentially hazardous chemicals
  • Must be able to climb ladders, occasionally up to an 8-foot ladder safely

Maintenance Technician Education and Experience:

  • A valid in-state driver's license is required
  • A high school diploma or equivalent is preferred
  • Previous home refurbishment or make-ready experience preferred
  • HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, and Pool Operation experience are a PLUS
  • OSHA certifications or completed trainings are a plus
  • Proficiency in industry specific software products including the use of electronic devices/tablets
